id: 07_EquiTips CPV Manufacturing High Pressure Valves & Fittings Explained
title: 高压阀门与接头的安全使用
source_doc: course/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/07_EquiTips CPV Manufacturing High Pressure Valves & Fittings Explained.md
author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/07_EquiTips CPV Manufacturing High Pressure Valves & Fittings Explained/src.py

points.K1: 高压气路用高压专用件
points.K4: 氧气阀门要经冲击测试
points.K5: 手柄平稳转动，不用加力
points.K6: 按介质和额定压力使用

shots.scene: 欣欣站在气瓶汇流排前，墙上是一排黄铜高压阀门和细管，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a gas cylinder manifold with a row of brass high-pressure valves and thin tubing on the wall, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲高压阀门和接头的安全使用。
overlay: 高压阀门与接头的安全使用

shots.scene: 油滴打叉、慢转箭头、侧站小人、扳手打叉四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an oil drop crossed out, a slow turning arrow, a person standing to the side, and a wrench crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 禁油、慢开、侧站、带压不拆。

shots.scene: 阿杰刚吃完东西，手指油乎乎地伸向氧气阀门手柄
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, fingers greasy from a snack, reaches toward the handle of an oxygen manifold valve.
shots.narration: 阿杰手上沾着油，就要去开氧气阀。

shots.scene: 油手和氧气阀门之间冒出火花图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oily hand on an oxygen valve with a spark between them, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 油碰上高压氧，可能起火！

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰洗手液和干净手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student hand soap and a pair of clean gloves.
shots.narration: 小研让他先洗手，戴上干净手套。

shots.section_title: 高压气路用高压专用件
shots.scene: 汇流排示意：几只气瓶经高压阀门汇入一条管路
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cylinder manifold: several cylinders connected through high-pressure valves into one header pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶汇流排上，用的是高压阀门和接头。
overlay: 高压气路用高压专用件

shots.section_title: 高压气路用高压专用件
shots.scene: 普通水管阀门接在高压气路上的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an ordinary plastic water tap fitted on a high-pressure gas line, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能拿普通阀门、管件凑合。

shots.scene: 一个旧阀门旁边有日历和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: An older brass valve next to a calendar icon and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 好阀门能用很多年。

shots.scene: 老李用放大镜检查阀门螺纹和手柄
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a valve's threads and handle with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 但用得再久，也要定期检查。

shots.scene: 阀门在清洗槽里，然后进测试台，最后装进密封袋
shots.prompt_en: A sequence: a valve in a cleaning tank, then on a test bench, then sealed in a clean plastic bag. No people.
shots.narration: 出厂前要清洗、测试，再密封包装。

shots.scene: 密封袋上贴着空白的氧气清洁标签
shots.prompt_en: A sealed bag with a valve inside and a blank label with an oxygen symbol and a clean check icon. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气用的阀门，必须清洁无油。

shots.scene: 老李戴干净手套，到现场才拆开包装
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing clean gloves, opens the sealed valve bag only at the installation site.
shots.narration: 到安装时再拆包，别沾上油污。

shots.section_title: 氧气阀门要经冲击测试
shots.scene: 高压氧快速冲进阀门，阀芯处变红发热的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of high-pressure oxygen rushing into a valve, the seat area glowing red with heat. No people.
shots.narration: 高压氧猛地冲进来，会压缩发热。
overlay: 氧气阀门要经冲击测试

shots.section_title: 氧气阀门要经冲击测试
shots.scene: 测试台上的阀门旁有打勾的空白证书
shots.prompt_en: A valve on a test rig next to a blank certificate with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气阀门的设计，要经过冲击测试。

shots.section_title: 手柄平稳转动，不用加力
shots.scene: 老李戴手套平稳转动十字手柄
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing clean gloves, turns a cross-shaped valve handle smoothly with one hand.
shots.narration: 手柄设计好，高压下也能平稳转动。
overlay: 手柄平稳转动，不用加力

shots.section_title: 手柄平稳转动，不用加力
shots.scene: 长管套在手柄上加力、锤子敲阀门的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a long pipe slipped over a valve handle and a hammer hitting the valve, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 转不动就停下，不用加力杆和锤子。

shots.section_title: 按介质和额定压力使用
shots.scene: 阀门铭牌特写，旁边是氧气和惰性气体两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a blank valve nameplate with an oxygen icon and an inert gas icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 每个阀门都有额定压力。
overlay: 按介质和额定压力使用

shots.section_title: 按介质和额定压力使用
shots.scene: 两根刻度条：氧气那根比惰性气体那根短
shots.prompt_en: Two bar gauges side by side: the oxygen bar limit is lower than the inert gas bar limit. No people.
shots.narration: 同一阀门，用于氧气时允许压力更低。

shots.section_title: 按介质和额定压力使用
shots.scene: 老李对照空白说明书核对铭牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares the valve nameplate with a blank manual.
shots.narration: 按铭牌和说明书使用，不能超压。

shots.scene: 管螺纹、O形圈密封、焊接三种连接图标
shots.prompt_en: Three connection icons: a threaded pipe end, an O-ring seal fitting and a welded joint. No people.
shots.narration: 连接方式有多种，要和系统匹配。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰核对空白采购单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank purchase form together.
shots.narration: 从正规渠道采购，有疑问问供应商。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生培训，桌上有空白证书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator trains the female graduate student and the young male student, with blank certificates on the table.
shots.narration: 操作高压气路，先培训、获授权。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是气瓶和汇流排图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing icons of cylinders and a manifold.
shots.narration: 气瓶和高压容器，按特种设备管理。

shots.scene: 油壶、护手霜、油手套图标被红叉划掉，旁边氧气阀门
shots.prompt_en: Next to an oxygen valve icon, an oil can, a hand cream tube and an oily glove are crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气阀门、管路严禁油脂。

shots.scene: 小研用干净手套慢慢开启氧气阀门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing clean gloves, slowly opens an oxygen valve a little at a time.
shots.narration: 开氧气阀要慢，一点一点开。

shots.scene: 只用标有氧气适用的零件，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A set of valve parts with blank oxygen-service tags and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气系统只用适用于氧气的零件。

shots.scene: 小研站在阀门侧面开阀，出口方向没有人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands to the side of the valve while opening it, nobody in front of the outlet.
shots.narration: 开阀时人站侧面，不正对出口。

shots.scene: 人正对阀门出口的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing directly in front of a valve outlet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 脸和身体别对着出口和压力表。

shots.scene: 老李关闭上游阀门，压力表指针回零
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the upstream cylinder valves and watches the blank gauge drop to zero.
shots.narration: 换接头前，关气源，泄压到零。

shots.scene: 扳手拧带压接头的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench on a fitting while the gauge needle is still high, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压力管路不得带压拆卸、紧固。

shots.scene: 老李在新接头上涂检漏液，没有冒泡，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer brushes leak detection solution on a new fitting; no bubbles appear, with a green check.
shots.narration: 换完先检漏，确认不漏再用。

shots.scene: 高压接头处喷出气流，发出尖啸声的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a high-pressure jet of gas shooting from a failed fitting with loud sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 高压泄漏，气流又猛又响。

shots.scene: 小研带阿杰远离，撤到走廊
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student away from the manifold into the corridor.
shots.narration: 人员先远离，不要用手去堵。

shots.scene: 老李在远端关闭总阀
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the main supply valve at a safe distance from the leak.
shots.narration: 能安全操作时，在远端关闭气源。

shots.scene: 氧气泄漏区域的烟头和火焰图标被红叉划掉，衣服上飘着氧气符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oxygen leak area with a cigarette and a flame crossed out, and a jacket with an oxygen symbol drifting from it. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气泄漏处禁火，衣服沾了氧远离火。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，必要时拨打119、120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现高压阀门、铭牌和密封包装图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a high-pressure valve, a nameplate and a sealed clean bag.
shots.narration: 高压专用件，按介质和额定值用。

shots.scene: 禁油、慢转、侧站三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a no-oil symbol, a slow turning arrow and a person standing to the side. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气禁油，慢慢开，人站侧面。

shots.scene: 压力表回零、检漏泡泡、出口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gauge at zero, leak test bubbles and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 泄压再拆，换件检漏，泄漏先撤。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的汇流排前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of a tidy cylinder manifold with brass valves.
shots.narration: 高压不着急，慢慢来最安全，下次见！
